content: Implement the first M0130 W0133 target-constrained preflight slice: validate the W0131 Vulkan profile and target digest before future SPIR-V lowering, enforce workgroup/address-space/subgroup constraints, and provide stable negative diagnostics without claiming MLIR conversion or execution.

Content revision 86441c7 adds target preflight validation to the Vulkan runtime. It checks the queried profile, required feature bits, target digest, workgroup dimensions/invocations, known address spaces, BDA declaration, and subgroup-width assumptions with stable status values.

Vulkan configure/build and full CTest passed 85/85, including target-preflight positive and negative fixtures; Agent records and git diff checks passed. MLIR conversion, SPIR-V validation, pipeline creation, and execution remain unimplemented.
